name: Manatee
one_liner: Virtual family therapy and parent coaching for kids and teens, plus a free app with goals, rewards and coping skills for families.
best_for: Parents of children or teens with anxiety, behavior or mood concerns who want the family involved in care
Families who want video therapy and parent coaching from home
Parents and teens who want a free app for goals, rewards and coping skills
not_for: Anyone in crisis: call or text 988
Adults seeking therapy for themselves alone
Children who need medication management or intensive in-person care
Families outside the US states where Manatee's clinicians are licensed
short_description: Video family therapy and parent coaching for kids and teens, with a free companion app; starts with a free 20-minute consult.
long_description: Manatee offers virtual family care for children and teens: after a free 20-minute consult, families are matched with licensed therapists and parent coaches and follow a 6-week care plan with weekly sessions, according to its App Store listing. The free Manatee app for parents and adolescents includes goals and rewards, a mindfulness chatbot, expert-led courses and family connection activities, and can be used on its own. Therapy is offered only in the US states where its clinicians are licensed, and Manatee accepts some insurance plans; check coverage and self-pay rates at the consult. We found no published study of Manatee's program.
patient_summary: You start with a free 20-minute consult, then your child and family meet a licensed therapist or parent coach by video, usually weekly over a 6-week plan. The free app gives you and your child goals, rewards and coping exercises between sessions. Ask about insurance and self-pay costs at the consult.

pricing.starting_price: Free app and free 20-minute consult; therapy copay with insurance (self-pay rate not verified)
pricing.notes: The app is free. Manatee accepts some insurance plans; we could not open its own pricing page to confirm self-pay session rates.

privacy.notes: Policy (read 2026-10-27) says Manatee does not sell personal information, but combines website cookie data with data from marketing partners to build a profile used for personalized advertising based on your interests and browsing; deletion on request.

faqs.a: Video therapy sessions with licensed clinicians for children ages 5-18 and their families, plus a free app with goal-setting, activities, and a chatbot. This is real therapy with human therapists, not an AI chatbot or self-help app.

faqs.q: How much does Manatee cost without insurance?
faqs.a: $220 for the initial intake session (45-60 min), then $200 per 55-minute session. FSA/HSA funds accepted. Superbills provided for out-of-network reimbursement.
Many BCBS plans, UnitedHealthcare, Optum, Anthem, Oscar, Humana Military, Magellan, and others. Coverage varies by state. Does NOT accept Medicare or Medicaid.

faqs.q: What states is Manatee available in?
faqs.a: Currently 11 states: California, Colorado, Florida, Idaho, Illinois, Kansas, New Jersey, Oklahoma, Pennsylvania, and Texas. Expanding to more states.

primary_uses: Video family therapy for children and teens
Goals, rewards and coping skills practice in the app

availability.note: Therapy only in the US states where Manatee's clinicians are licensed; the app itself is free to download.
